## In one sentence

Hypothesis testing compares data with a reference model to assess whether the
data are unusually inconsistent with a null claim.

## The workflow

State the estimand and hypotheses, choose a test statistic, specify the null
reference distribution, and define the decision rule before looking at results.
A p-value is the probability, under the null model, of data at least as extreme
as those observed.

A p-value is not the probability that the null hypothesis is true, nor the size
or importance of an effect.

## Errors and decisions

A Type I error rejects a true null; a Type II error fails to reject a false null.
The significance level $\alpha$ controls the long-run Type I error rate under the
specified procedure. Power is the chance of detecting a chosen alternative.

::: {.callout-important}
"Fail to reject" does not mean "prove no effect." Pair the decision with an
effect estimate, interval, and sensitivity to assumptions.
:::

## Check your understanding

Write a null hypothesis and a practically meaningful alternative for a treatment
that is expected to change mean recovery time.
